name: Filter Term
description: Admin page to find and list nodes filtered by vocabulary, term, content type, title and author.
project_description:
This module filters and fetch all our nodes on the basis of vocabulary, taxonomy term and content type and also fetch node by title and users name. 
 Features 
 
 Filter all our taxonomy terms basis on the vocablary.(when you select vocabulary it will load related to the taxonomy term then we can filter our nodes on the basis of selected taxonomy terms, vocabulary and content type) 
 Filter nodes by the content type and authors 
 Fetch node from nodes by title and users name and also by the content type 
 Show Published and UnPublished of node list. 
 Reset form functionality 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After Installation, Go to module directly by "Configure" button and check the functionality of this module.

 Supporting this Module 
 Node and Taxonomy both core modules are Supporting in this module.
